The eager initial pg.reserve(charge_range*12) is temporary: pg.swap(new_peaks) precedes DS.push_back(pg). Do not multiply that reserve by retained candidate counts or assume its capacity survives the copy.

Matrix max logical35552bytes is also a small percall buffer, while its64m construction frequency is a separate allocator-cost hypothesis.

The three partial stage maxima are separate phases and may be different jobs/workers; never add them or multiply requested192 to claim measured live bytes/RSS. The source scope ends binning arrays before scoring.

SD log_mz_peaks_ clear+reserve and bitset resize can retain capacity across jobs and MS1→MS2. MS2 records mix such carried capacities with actual MS2-local stage geometry; similar maxima cannot establish typical MS2 work or an independent MS2 allocation footprint.
